people.name: Ji Xianlin
people.field: Indologist, linguist, paleographer, historian and writer

relations.subject: Ji Xianlin
relations.evidence: He attended Sanhejie Primary School and the No. 1 Middle School in Jinan, then Shandong University.

relations.subject: Ji Xianlin
relations.evidence: In 1930, he was admitted to Tsinghua University as a major in Western literature.

relations.subject: Ji Xianlin
relations.evidence: In 1935, he went to University of Göttingen as an exchange student... Ji received his PhD in 1941

relations.subject: Ji Xianlin
relations.evidence: choosing in 1936 to major in Sanskrit and less well known ancient languages, such as Pali, under Professor Ernst Waldschmidt.

relations.subject: Ji Xianlin
relations.evidence: Ji received his PhD in 1941, and then studied Tocharian under Emil Sieg.

relations.subject: Ji Xianlin
relations.evidence: In 1946, he returned to China, becoming a professor at Peking University under the recommendation of Chen Yinke

relations.subject: Ji Xianlin
relations.role: commissioner of the Chinese Academy of Sciences' Department of Social Science
relations.evidence: In 1956, he was elected commissioner of the Chinese Academy of Sciences' Department of Social Science.

relations.subject: Ji Xianlin
relations.evidence: In 1978, Ji became vice president of Peking University and director of the Chinese Academy of Science's Research Institute on South Asia.
